name: 上方圖片跑馬燈列＋下方留白文字帶
desc: 主視覺上方約七成是一整列持續往左流動的直式圖片，下方約三成是純色留白的文字帶，左側放大標題。
prompt: 主視覺分成上下兩段：上段約佔主視覺高的七成，是一整列並排的直式圖片，貼齊主視覺上緣與畫面左右兩側，同一組圖片比例一致，每張約佔畫面寬的三成，圖片之間只留很窄的縫隙；整列圖片持續往左流動，首尾接續、不停循環（跑馬燈）。下段約佔三成，是純色留白的文字帶。文字帶左側放大標題（可多行），靠左對齊，約佔畫面寬的三成，標題每行依序往右縮排、錯落排列。大標題左側可放一個小型標誌圖，下方搭配次要文字；大標題右側的空白處可放一個小插圖；沒有內容時省略，大標題的位置不變。
mobile: 上下兩段對調：留白文字帶移到上方，約佔三分之一高；圖片列移到下方，約佔三分之二高，貼齊主視覺下緣與畫面左右兩側，同時露出約兩張直式圖片，持續往左流動的跑馬燈保留。文字帶內，小型標誌圖與次要文字移到左上，大標題移到右側，每行依序往右縮排的錯落排列保留，完整落在畫面內不超出邊緣；小插圖移到大標題右下方。高度改為底邊約在畫面九成高的位置，下方露出下一個區塊的開頭。

en.name: Top image marquee strip + bottom blank text band
en.desc: The top ~70% of the hero is a full-width row of portrait images flowing continuously to the left; the bottom ~30% is a plain blank text band with the headline on the left.
en.prompt: The hero is split into two stacked parts. The upper part takes about seventy percent of the hero height and is a single row of portrait images side by side, flush with the top edge of the hero and the left and right edges of the viewport; all images share the same proportion, each about thirty percent of the viewport width, with only a very narrow gap between them. The whole row flows continuously to the left, end joined to start, looping without stopping (a marquee). The lower part takes about thirty percent and is a plain blank text band. On the left of the text band place a headline (may wrap to multiple lines), left-aligned, about thirty percent of the viewport width, with each line indented further to the right than the previous one in a staggered arrangement. Optionally place a small logo mark with secondary text below it to the left of the headline, and a small illustration in the empty space to the right of the headline; omit them when there is no content, without changing the position of the headline.
en.mobile: The two parts swap: the blank text band moves to the top, taking about one third of the height, and the image row moves to the bottom, taking about two thirds, flush with the bottom edge of the hero and the left and right edges of the viewport, showing about two portrait images at once; the leftward marquee is kept. Inside the text band, the small logo mark and secondary text move to the top-left and the headline moves to the right, keeping the staggered arrangement where each line is indented further right, and stays fully within the viewport without overflowing the edge; the small illustration moves below and to the right of the headline. The height changes so the bottom edge sits at about ninety percent of the viewport height, revealing the start of the next section below.

accessories.prompt: 在主視覺右側、下段文字帶的右上放一個捲動提示：一個小標籤搭配一個小箭頭，箭頭有持續循環的小動態。
accessories.mobile: 捲動提示在手機版移到文字帶左下、圖片列正上方，靠左對齊。

en.prompt: Place a scroll indicator on the right side of the hero, at the top-right of the lower text band: a small label with a small arrow that has a continuously looping small motion.
en.mobile: On mobile the scroll indicator moves to the bottom-left of the text band, directly above the image row, left-aligned.
